target.name: Marketing image with context-dependent alt purpose

findings.target_and_state: Marketing hero image in source-only state
findings.title: Alt text purpose cannot be confirmed without editorial context

evidence.description: A non-empty alt attribute exists, but adjacent copy and image purpose were not supplied.

reproduction_steps: Inspect the image metadata and note that the alt attribute is non-empty.
Compare it with the missing page/editorial context.
findings.user_impact: An irrelevant or redundant description may add noise or omit the image's purpose.
findings.recommended_repair: Have a content owner decide whether the image is informative, functional, or decorative and write the appropriate alternative.
verification_steps: Review the image in page context with the content owner.
Test the resulting reading sequence with a screen reader.

evidence_log.description: Attribute presence was confirmed; purpose remains unknown.
